projects.title: 2013 OSU Marching Band Sustainability and Efficiency Initiative
projects.description:
Along with project partner Charlie King, I am working to outfit the entire OSU Marching Band with iPads to eliminate 100% of the band's paper usage. By using tablets, the band will become more efficient and productive during rehearsal. All band members will have the most current version and technology can be used to better communicate information. Marching Drill will also be animated in front of the band member on the field for the first time, a groundbreaking innovation. 

$25,000 has been donated by the Ohio State Office of Energy and Sustainability for the 2013 season. We will be conducting a pilot program to test the product and work out any issues before the full rollout in 2014.

projects.title: 2012 JP Morgan Code for Good Challenge
projects.description: Our team developed the application idea chosen by the non-profit group Community Shelter Board for development by JP Morgan professional developers.  From 7 teams from around the country our idea was selected after a 15 hour planning and developing session culminating in both technical and non-technical presentations in front a panel of notable technologists from the Columbus, OH area.
